# Concord: the leading power invites an independent ruler into h_ck_terra.
# root = invited ruler, scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader = holder of h_ck_terra
ck_struggles.0020 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_struggles.0020.t
	desc = ck_struggles.0020.desc
	theme = diplomacy
	left_portrait = scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader
	trigger = {
		is_independent_ruler = yes
		scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader = {
			is_alive = yes
			has_title = title:h_ck_terra
		}
	}
	option = {	# enter the hegemony
		name = ck_struggles.0020.a
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = swear_fealty
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader
			change = scope:change
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_terra_concord_member_modifier years = 50 }
		add_opinion = { target = scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader modifier = ck_struggle_concord_joined_opinion }
		hidden_effect = {
			ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = { HEG = h_ck_terra BLOC = ckworld_earth FOUNDER = scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader }
			scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader = { add_prestige = 50 }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { add = 50 is_allied_to = scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader }
			modifier = { add = -30 highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
			opinion_modifier = { opinion_target = scope:ck_struggle_concord_leader }
		}
	}
	option = {	# remain sovereign
		name = ck_struggles.0020.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { add = 30 has_trait = ambitious }
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = arrogant }
		}
	}
}
